sources.title: GitHub - jaredpalmer/kev: tiny Jev-like family of decision models built ...
sources.snippet: Jev-inspired decision model. Typed questions in, calibrated probabilities out, one forward pass. kev is a LoRA adapter and a small readout head on top of Qwen2.5-0.5B. It reads a document once and answers many typed questions about it in parallel, in a single prefill pass with no decoding.
